translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 突然なにを……」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I knew I had to stay alive to greet you.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「You could've died for all I care.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: As they say, old soldiers never die, they just fade away.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Hehe, he's happy about reuniting with Rance-sama.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: What is this thick burnt-brown scream!」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: a giant man who nearly reached the tent ceiling appeared.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「I've heard rumors about Supreme Leader Rance for a long time!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I've wanted to meet you once!」
